domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, instafinancials.com returned only a generic product landing page with no company data, and the web_search backend was unavailable ("searx: Connection refused") for all queries. The only India-side counterparties visible are the Nepali buyers in the customs rows above (Classic View Resort, C.G Hotels Resorts, Himalaya Hospitality, Hotel Saffron CK, The Metropolitan Hotel, Grand Central Hotel, Jagdamba Hospitality) — these are cross-border exports, not domestic Indian supply. No domestic Indian buyer, contract or GST figure was seen.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely claimed: dated India customs records with destination, HS code and B/L number exist (latest 2026-02-12), predominantly Nepal land-border lanes (Raxaul, Sonauli) plus Singapore air cargo. Declared HS 851769 is broadly consistent with the observed rows (85176290, 85171890) — networking/telephony equipment — so no HS correction is needed; note that other rows carry 90106000 (projector lift) and 83016000, i.e. the company ships mixed project/AV hardware, not a single HS line. Role is manufacturer_trader/unknown: the company appears as an importer of ALE International (France) and Crestron Singapore equipment and re-exports/supplies it, so it is at minimum a trader-integrator, not a pure manufacturer. Domestic Indian supply evidence: следов поставок внутри Индии не найдено — no GST turnover, GeM/CPPP award or Indian buyer record was retrievable within the tool budget; this is a data-access gap, not proof of absence. Revenue and export volume in figures: null (ImportKey shows only a record count of 845, not a value; no rupee/dollar turnover figure is public in the sources read). No CIN, PAN or GSTIN was confirmed from a primary registry — left null rather than guessed.
